item.title: Pakistan rejects unilateral sanctions, vows to continue trade with Iran
item.description: Islamabad, IRNA – Pakistan will continue bilateral trade with Iran in accordance with international law and is not bound by unilateral sanctions imposed on Tehran, Pakistani Foreign Ministry spokesperson Tahir Andrabi has said.
